text_runs: I ASKED OUT OF THE BLUE.
KAEDE−CHAN STIFFENED,

HER EYES WIDENING. I DID
NOT KNOW HOW

TO INTERPRET IT, BUT
THERE WAS A HINT OF

UNEASE IN HER
EXPRESSION.
「KAEDE−ONEECHAN

LOVES KOICHI−ONIICHAN
TOO, FOR SURE,」

HATSUNE−CHAN HAD SAID.
EVEN IF SHE HAD

ONLY SAID IT TO COMFORT
ME, RIGHT NOW,

I FELT LIKE CLINGING TO
THOSE WORDS.

「DO YOU HATE TALKING TO
ME BECAUSE YOU DISLIKE
ME?」

I ASKED ONCE MORE,
KEEPING MY EYES FIXED
STRAIGHT ON

KAEDE−CHAN. EVEN IF SHE
ANSWERED THAT SHE
DISLIKED

ME, I INTENDED TO JUST
SMILE AND RESPOND
CHEERFULLY,

THINKING, 「WELL, I GUESS IT CANNOT BE HELPED
THEN.」

...BUT. BUT KAEDE−CHAN
CAST

HER EYES DOWN, LOOKED
DOWN,

AND SLOWLY SHOOK HER
HEAD FROM SIDE TO SIDE.
HER BLACK

BOB CUT DANCED BACK AND
FORTH, SWAYING RIGHT AND
LEFT.
